issues.body: The PR changes `scripts/coverage.sh` so `sparq-reason` includes the entire feature-gated Datalog module in its line-coverage denominator, but leaves the floor at 90 from the prior default-feature-only measurement. The new note explicitly says no with-Datalog measurement was taken. Consequently the PR provides no evidence that the coverage gate passes, and the committed floor no longer represents the surface the script measures. Deferring re-seeding to a later CI-driven change makes this ratchet update incomplete and may make the coverage job deterministically fail if the expanded percentage is below 90.
issues.fix_hint: Run the exact updated coverage command in the pinned CI/toolchain environment, capture the `sparq-reason` with-Datalog percentage, and update this entry in the same PR using the repository's seed procedure (including the intentional larger-denominator lowering path if required). If the measured result still supports floor 90, record that measurement in the note instead of saying the floor is unmeasured.
issues.title: Coverage floor is unvalidated for the newly expanded denominator

verdict.summary: The coverage command is wired correctly to compile and test `sparq-reason` with its default features plus `datalog`, but the change is incomplete as a coverage-ratchet update: it deliberately retains a floor derived from a different, smaller denominator without providing any measurement showing that the expanded surface satisfies that floor. The accompanying documentation acknowledges that the number is not a measurement and defers the necessary re-seed. Land the measured floor (or evidence that the existing floor remains valid) with the wiring so the committed gate is reproducible and known to pass.
